what_supports: Exploratory low-dimensional full-H mature-feedback ledger separates branch and combiner states, with reproducible scores.
Primary LS numeric-online+LLM5-online improves SocialGood mean MSE by 0.364959%, 1/3 seeds; Energy worsens 2.799824%, 0/3 seeds improve.
Secondary numeric-online+LLM5-static LS improves over numeric-online by Energy 8.699381% and SocialGood 1.455439%, 3/3 seeds each, while still losing to strong static controls.
LLM5-online versus raw5-online improves mean MSE Energy 7.129563% (2/3) and SocialGood 0.634104% (3/3).
Static/static LS improves over equal weighting by Energy 0.661998% and SocialGood 0.043431%, each 2/3 seeds; small gains are retained.
Both numeric and LLM5 online branches underperform their own static versions on both datasets, supporting diagnosis of online-update deterioration in this setup.
Dual adapter total parameter count 32128 versus 166832; lower isolated update microbenchmark cost, but slower dual-online prediction.
what_not_supports: Stable improvement from primary LS over numeric, text, equal weighting or existing Hedge.
Text contribution beyond strong numeric-static baseline; all LLM5 LS scenarios fail to beat that strong control in mean MSE.
Text semantic complementarity, content causality, benefits of a full zero-text learning/deployment policy.
New LS/Hedge algorithm, statistical significance, untouched-period confirmation, universal SOTA or deployment throughput.
192-byte gate-array payload as total memory/state/communication, or format-valid LLM outputs as semantically verified.
missing_evidence: Residual-exclusive text information relative to strong numeric-static after separating generic shrinkage and online-update deterioration.
Matched full learning-policy content/no-content controls and verified donor mismatch for semantic interpretation.
Untouched temporal/domain confirmation with dependence-aware uncertainty if stronger claims are pursued.
Verified publication-time, full VoT comparison, original submission/official source provenance.
revisedclaim: 在已见 Energy/SocialGood 的 OT/H6、三个优化 seed 上，全窗口成熟反馈账本揭示校准效果依赖分支更新状态。主要在线+在线 LS 在 SocialGood 有0.365%的探索性均值改善但仅1/3 seed，Energy退化2.800%；静态文本次场景相对在线数值分支改善，却未超过强静态对照。保留小幅/异质分支与集成收益，尚不主张语义互补性、新算法或稳定组合优势。
targetednext_actions: Read-only diagnostic residual decomposition relative to numeric-static using existing forecasts; no assessment-based tuning.
Prefer C strong frozen numeric base, require B residual-exclusive text evidence before one bounded residual-correction pilot with necessary controls; no giant module/grid expansion.
If advanced, lock one mechanism for new-period confirmation; otherwise retain baseline and narrow claims.
